description: This file is a Python script that manages repository processing, parallel execution, and output formatting for a project related to 'red_wing'. It includes functions for running loops, handling command-line arguments, and printing banners, with references to external modules 'red_wing.localization' and 'red_wing.cli_helpers'.

methods.name: print_banner

methods.name: run_loop
methods.description: Runs a single iteration of repository processing, either with or without improvements, and outputs metrics.
